design: Old metadata test archive is explicitly reused only for development scales and descriptive bias/covariance fitting. Frozen weights are not refitted. Then 32 new geometry-calibration clouds, public calibration freeze, then 32 new test clouds. Four fixed new plane-wave probes, four arms, 512 noise repeats per probe plus one separate held-out noisy readout. No selection of arms or fields after data.
seed_policy: Independent secrets.randbits(32) geometry seeds with replacement, excluding the recorded prior 128 cloud seeds and 0/1/4294967295 only. Duplicate new seeds retained. Independent secrets.randbits(128) measurement keys. All drawn once and published before target generation. Uniform independent seed selection and ideal independent Gaussian field noise are explicit statistical assumptions.
noise_model: Known zero-mean IID additive Gaussian input-field noise sigma=0.001, including one shared root reading and identical event readings across all four arms. N(C)=sigma^2 B(C)B(C)^T. Field probes have independent noise. Geometry and measurement RNG keys are separate. This is a synthetic calibration, not instrument data.
geometry_model: Clean operator residual e(C,f)=B(C)f-Lf; includes reconstruction, discretization and selection error. Mean bias and between-cloud covariance are reported separately for each field. No assertion that this covariance is conditional on a cloud or an embedding covariance. Independent proper-time/Gram/relation diagnostics evaluate actual geometry.
interval: Fixed development scales include uncentered clean second moment plus estimated mean-fit variance. A split-conformal maximum over all 16 clean outputs yields one geometry radius multiplier (rank ceil((n+1)*0.96)); an unavailable finite quantile causes abstention. Add Bonferroni Gaussian measurement radii for all 16 outputs at total error 0.01. No bias is subtracted from operator outputs. Nominal >=95% simultaneous marginal coverage requires exchangeable accepted clouds and the declared noise model, averaged over calibration draws; not conditional coverage for every observed cloud or a fixed calibration set.
decision: CALIBRATION_COMPONENTS_SUPPORTED only if complete within-budget execution, source/independent checks, finite calibration, minimum availability, all 4096-budget noise consistency tests and both defective-covariance controls pass, and at least 90% of complete test clouds have simultaneous total-interval coverage. Otherwise CALIBRATION_HOLD. This is a bounded calibration pilot, not an empirical proof of population 95% coverage. Report exact binomial coverage uncertainty separately; always HOLD_PHASE3 and HOLD_EMBEDDING_COVARIANCE. No Kalman gain or relation-projection metric is changed.
stop: All 64 scheduled clouds exactly once; no replacement, extra seeds, result-based changes or retries after statistical failure. Write each record and execution telemetry immediately. A worker exception preserves its incomplete evidence and prevents support status. Reanalysis/replay of identical seeds and data is allowed only for verification, not as extra evidence.
